subject: Post-demo: SDK setup & structured tool-calling (LuminHealth)
messages:
From: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.com>
To: Sam Huang <sam@luminhealth.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-08-15T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Post-demo: SDK setup & structured tool-calling (LuminHealth)

Hi Sam / Lumin team,

Thanks again for the demo this morning — great session. Quick recap and proposed next steps to get your POC calling the structured tool-calling flow reliably: 

- What we covered: SDK quickstart, auth token rotation, structured output/tool-calling (tools: reranker + database connector), embeddings config for semantic search.
- Immediate ask (you): share the failing request payloads + any error traces from your app (we can redact PII).
- Our deliverable: a short repro plan and patch (if needed) within 48 business hours after we have a failing sample.

Notes / recommendations from the call:
- Use the SDK v0.9.4+ (fixed transient auth refresh bug). If you're on an earlier SDK, upgrading often resolves 401/timeout edge cases.
- For structured tool-calling, keep tool response schemas strict (we'll share an example template).
- If you anticipate high concurrency, configure conservative batching: max_batch_size=8, max_latency_ms=25 as a starting point.

Can you send over a sample 502/5xx payload if you see it? If it's easier, drop the sample here or attach a small file. Laura and Marissa from infra will take point on repro.

Thanks — Jordan
Jordan Blake
Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
jordan_blake@redwood.com
From: Sam Huang <sam@luminhealth.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.com>
Cc: integrations@luminhealth.com
Date: 2027-08-15T11:05:42-07:00
Subject: Re: Post-demo: SDK setup & structured tool-calling (LuminHealth)

Jordan — thanks. Attached is a small sample from our staging app where we see intermittent 502s calling the structured tool endpoint. We capture the request + the error in our logs.

Error snippet: 
HTTP/1.1 502 Bad Gateway
Content-Type: application/json
{
  "error": "upstream_runtime_error",
  "message": "runtime exception while executing rpc: KV cache mismatch at step 12"
}

Payload (redacted):
{
  "model": "redwood-structured-1.0",
  "input": {"query": "Find similar patient notes for cough and fever"},
  "tools": [{"name": "reranker", "params": {"top_k": 50, "embedding_model": "embed-3"}}],
  "batching": {"enabled": true, "max_batch_size": 16}
}

We attached app-error-sample.json with the above and a couple of repeated failing timestamps. Not sure yet if it is SDK-side or server-side. We're on SDK v0.9.4.

Sam Huang
Head of Integrations, LuminHealth
sam@luminhealth.com
From: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-08-15T12:01:10-07:00
Subject: Fwd: Post-demo: SDK setup & structured tool-calling (LuminHealth) — 502 repro sample

Marissa / Ben / Priyom — forwarding Sam's failing payload and 502 trace from staging. Key details:
- SDK v0.9.4 on their side (so not an ancient SDK).
- Batching enabled with max_batch_size=16 (they defaulted higher after load test).
- Error indicates a runtime path (KV cache mismatch).

Can we:
1) Attempt to reproduce with the same payload using a non-batched call and a batched call locally against our staging environment.
2) Check whether recent KV cache changes (late July) could lead to a cache-key mismatch under higher batch sizes.
3) If you need it, I'll ask Sam for their exact curl + SDK logs.

I've marked this P0 for the POC; need a repro plan within 24 hours so we can share a patch or mitigation (suggested mitigation: temporarily reduce batch size to 4).

-Jordan
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-08-16T09:30:05-07:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: Post-demo: SDK setup & structured tool-calling (LuminHealth) — 502 repro sample

Thanks — I've triaged the sample briefly. First-pass notes:

- The 502 with "KV cache mismatch" strongly suggests a race condition when requests in the same batch reference overlapping cache keys.
- We rolled a KV cache optimization on 2027-07-29 that touched cache key normalization; I want to rule that in/out.

Immediate action items for repro: 
- Jordan: ask Sam to run two quick experiments and paste results here: 
  1) Same payload with batching disabled (SDK param max_batch_size=1 or disable batching).
  2) Same payload with reduced batch size (max_batch_size=4).
- Ben / Priyom: we'll spin a local repro harness using the exact payload and the two batching scenarios. I'll attach the collector script and a trimmed server-side log sampling.

Attached for internal use: sdk-debug-log.txt (collected from a local run where I reproduced a single 502 using batched calls). The log includes a short stack trace and the request id for correlation.

We should also confirm whether they are using the reranker as an inline tool (synchronous call) vs. an external tool invocation — that changes KV semantics.

Marissa
Marissa Cole
Sr. Infrastructure Engineer | Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.com

Attachment: sdk-debug-log.txt (text)
From: Sam Huang <sam@luminhealth.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.com>
Cc: integrations@luminhealth.com
Date: 2027-08-17T16:48:22-07:00
Subject: Re: Post-demo: SDK setup & structured tool-calling (LuminHealth)

Jordan / team — quick updates from our side after trying Marissa's suggestion:

- We ran the non-batched call (SDK param batching.enabled=false) across the same test harness for ~200 requests. No 502s observed.
- With reduced batch size to 4, failures dropped dramatically (2/200 requests) vs 18/200 at batch_size=16.

Per your ask, here's the curl we used (tokens redacted):

curl -X POST https://api.redwood.example/v1/structured_tool_call 
  -H "Authorization: Bearer REDACTED" 
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" 
  -d '{"model":"redwood-structured-1.0","input":{"query":"Find similar patient notes for cough and fever"},"tools":[{"name":"reranker","params":{"top_k":50,"embedding_model":"embed-3"}}],"batching":{"enabled":true,"max_batch_size":16}}'

So this strongly points to a batching-related race (your logs look similar to Marissa's local repro). Temporary mitigation for us is to pin max_batch_size=4 in staging/POC.

Let us know if you'd like us to leave the staging test harness running overnight with reduced batch size while you push any fixes. Happy to keep sending logs.

Sam
Sam Huang
Head of Integrations, LuminHealth
sam@luminhealth.com
Notes: Thread contains attached stubs (app-error-sample.json, sdk-debug-log.txt). Internal participants will use these to reproduce the issue.
